name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.272.0 — Genesis journey check accepts workspace hosts: Storybook reports a journey story's path from its own project root (src/journeys) while design-paths names it from the repo root (apps/web/src/journeys), so every journey was refused; the check now matches the journeys folder or a /-bounded suffix of it. 7.271.0 — Genesis’s journey-stories step names Fable like the brief and kit steps (it named Sonnet, and an Opus session read that as a forced downward switch and stopped); genesis.md states that every design step names Fable and a session already on Fable works in place; a test pins all three Session: lines. 7.270.0 — Critical tier enforces its own rules: core § Runtime Verification says a critical spec's own env-gated test must still execute (its skip stays hard), § Tiers says literal examples are refused at lock by ac-matrix --lint (missing-literal), and the spec template AC comment names both.
